# Clearline HTTP API

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:api` from src/api/routes.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

All endpoints are JSON unless noted. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Tenant-scoped paths (`/api/v1/tenants/:tenant/...`) are authorized against the token's tenant before the handler runs; a token for another tenant receives `403 cross_tenant_denied`, and the attempt is audited in both tenants.

Every response carries `X-Correlation-Id` (send your own to correlate client and server logs). Errors have the shape `{"error": {"code", "message", "details?"}, "correlation_id"}`.

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 200 / 201 | Success / created |
| 202 | Accepted for asynchronous processing (batches) or awaiting approval (breaking contract) |
| 400 | Malformed request (unknown source, bad control totals, invalid filter) |
| 401 | Missing, invalid or revoked token |
| 403 | Role lacks the permission, or cross-tenant access |
| 404 | Not found within your tenant |
| 409 | State conflict (migration pending, version exists, rollback window closed) |
| 422 | Rejected: invalid contract, unsafe migration, structurally invalid payload |

## Operational endpoints

| Method | Path | Auth | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/healthz` | public | Liveness: the process is up. |
| GET | `/readyz` | public | Readiness: database reachable and no pending migrations (503 otherwise). |
| GET | `/metrics` | `METRICS_TOKEN` bearer if set | Prometheus text format: HTTP, batch, row and auth counters; backlog, oldest queued age, freshness and live-worker gauges. |

## Platform and identity

| Method | Path | Roles | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/me` | any valid token | Describe the calling principal (tenant, role, permissions). |
| GET | `/api/v1/contract-schema` | public | The formal JSON Schema (2020-12) for tenant contracts. |
| POST | `/api/v1/tenants` | platform_admin | Create a tenant (schema, reporting role, retention policy). Body: {id, name, retention?}. |

## Tokens

| Method | Path | Roles | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/tenants/:tenant/tokens` | platform_admin, admin | Issue an API token (admin\|operator\|reporter by tenant admins; first admin and approver tokens by the platform admin). Token is returned once. |
| GET | `/api/v1/tenants/:tenant/tokens` | platform_admin, admin | List the tenant's API tokens (names, roles, revocation state; never secrets). |
| POST | `/api/v1/tenants/:tenant/tokens/:name/revoke` | platform_admin, admin | Revoke a token by name; effective on the next request. |

## Tenants

| Method | Path | Roles | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/tenants/:tenant` | admin, approver, operator, reporter | Tenant details and retention policy. |

## Contracts

| Method | Path | Roles | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/tenants/:tenant/contracts` | admin, approver, operator, reporter | All contract versions with lifecycle state. |
| GET | `/api/v1/tenants/:tenant/contracts/active` | admin, approver, operator, reporter | The active contract document. |
| POST | `/api/v1/tenants/:tenant/contracts/validate` | admin, approver, operator, reporter | Dry run: validate a contract and show the migration plan without changing anything. |
| POST | `/api/v1/tenants/:tenant/contracts` | admin | Publish a contract version. 201 = applied; 202 = breaking, awaiting approval; 422 = invalid or rejected. |

## Migrations

| Method | Path | Roles | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/tenants/:tenant/migrations` | admin, approver, operator, reporter | Contract migrations with plans and approval state. |
| POST | `/api/v1/tenants/:tenant/migrations/:id/approve` | approver | Approve and apply a pending breaking migration (approver role). Body: {confirm_version}. |
| POST | `/api/v1/tenants/:tenant/migrations/:id/reject` | approver | Reject a pending migration. Body: {reason}. |
| POST | `/api/v1/tenants/:tenant/migrations/:id/rollback` | approver | Roll back an applied migration (only before any batch uses the new version). |

## Batches

| Method | Path | Roles | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/tenants/:tenant/batches` | admin, operator | Submit a JSON batch. Body: {source, source_reported_at?, control?: {record_count?, sums?}, records: [...]}. |
| POST | `/api/v1/tenants/:tenant/batches/csv` | admin, operator | Submit a CSV file (Content-Type: text/csv). Query: source, source_reported_at?. Header X-Clearline-Control: JSON control totals. |
| GET | `/api/v1/tenants/:tenant/batches` | admin, operator, reporter | List batches (newest first). Query: status?, source?, limit?. |
| GET | `/api/v1/tenants/:tenant/batches/:id` | admin, operator, reporter | Batch detail: provenance, counts, attempts, submissions, quality results and reconciliation. |
| GET | `/api/v1/tenants/:tenant/batches/:id/findings` | admin, operator | Per-record quality findings for a batch (affected records). Query: rule_id?, limit?. |
| POST | `/api/v1/tenants/:tenant/batches/:id/replay` | admin, operator | Re-queue a failed batch for processing (safe: failed attempts left no effects). |

## Quarantine

| Method | Path | Roles | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/tenants/:tenant/quarantine` | admin, operator | Quarantined records with actionable reasons. Query: status=open\|resolved\|all, batch_id?. |
| POST | `/api/v1/tenants/:tenant/quarantine/:id/resolve` | admin, operator | Mark a quarantined record resolved. Body: {resolution}. The record is not admitted; resubmit corrected data. |

## Examples

```sh
T=cl_dev_northwind_operator
# Submit a CSV batch with control totals
curl -sS -X POST "http://localhost:8080/api/v1/tenants/northwind/batches/csv?source=nw_medical_claims_csv&source_reported_at=2026-10-01T06:00:00Z" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $T" -H "Content-Type: text/csv" \
  -H 'X-Clearline-Control: {"record_count": 1000, "sums": {"paid_amount": "498911.75"}}' --data-binary @claims.csv
# Inspect it
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $T" http://localhost:8080/api/v1/tenants/northwind/batches/<batch_id>
# Reproducible filtered extract (same as_of + filters => same bytes and sha256)
curl -sS -G -H "Authorization: Bearer cl_dev_northwind_reporter" http://localhost:8080/api/v1/tenants/northwind/extracts/claims/csv \
  --data-urlencode 'filters={"status":"PAID","service_date":{"gte":"2026-06-01","lte":"2026-08-31"}}' --data-urlencode as_of=2026-10-19T21:00:00Z -D -
```

Extract responses include `X-Clearline-Export-Id`, `-Extract-Id`, `-Contract-Version`, `-As-Of`, `-Filters`, `-Row-Count`, `-Sha256`, `-Redacted-Fields` and `-Trust-Scope` headers. See `docs/examples/` for sample extracts and responses.
